title: Tonpet
blurb: A new wind instrument somewhere between a trumpet and a bassoon. The sound isn't samples: it's a physical model of a lip-reed and a conical reed blowing through a modelled air column, so your breath into the mic shapes and sustains every note. Record takes, capture what you play straight onto sheet music, or write notes on the staff and hear the Tonpet play them back. Save takes as WAV, MP3 or the original recording.
controls: Play: hold a key, blow into the mic (Mic) or slide the Air strip; slide sideways to bend. Rec captures notes to the sheet from the cursor and saves an audio take. Sheet: tap the paper to write a note, drag to move, tap the bar ruler to move the cursor, ▶ to hear it, Bounce to record it as a take. Computer: A–; and Q–T play, Space blows
